headline: 6月通膨降至3.5%
context: 美國6月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率降到3.5%，比5月的三年新高4.2%明顯趨緩，月增率也下滑0.8%，是2020年4月以來最大的單月降幅。不過隨著美伊衝突再度升溫，油價又開始往上衝，現在每加侖汽油價格比去年同期貴了70美分。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: The news of an improvement in consumer prices in June came as the U.S. and Iran escalated attacks, risking a return to high energy prices.
sources.title: White House Cheers Inflation Data While Iran War Sparks New Price Surge

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Recent strikes have sent oil prices climbing again, with average gas price per gallon up by 70 cents on last year Inflation cooled to an annual rate of 3.5% in June as the brief US-Iran ceasefire, which has since ended, brought energy prices down, according to new data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics. The consumer price index (CPI), which measures a basket of goods and services, has been elevated since the start of the war, largely because of higher energy prices. After mostly staying under 3% since mid-2024, CPI reached a three-year high of 4.2% in May – up from 2.4% in February. Month-over-month, CPI fell 0.8% in June, the largest one-month decrease since April 2020. Continue reading...
sources.title: Inflation cools to 3.5% in June in relief brought by brief US-Iran peace deal

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: While the US inflation rate fell in June, concerns remain over price rises increasing again due to the renewed conflict in the Middle East.
sources.title: Gas prices drive down US inflation - but will it last?

thread_text:
美國6月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率降到3.5%，比5月觸及的三年新高4.2%明顯趨緩，月增率也下滑0.8%，是2020年4月以來最大的單月降幅。白宮把這份數據當成好消息大肆宣傳。不過好消息背後有隱憂——隨著美伊衝突再度升溫，油價又開始往上衝，現在每加侖汽油價格比去年同期貴了70美分，先前短暫促成能源價格下滑的美伊停火，如今也已經破局。

——本則整理自 The New York Times、The Guardian 與 BBC 於 2026 年 7 月 15 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
